support_claim: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party, and the packet instructs treating that registry link as unresolved despite billing and the MSA sharing the Inc. name.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing identity and DISTINCT requires establishing distinctness; shared naming between billing and the MSA counterparty is compatibility, not identity proof, and the notes preserve multiple live registry candidates (Inc. vs. Wyoming LLC) without resolving which is the contracting party. Neither positive nor negative burden is met, so UNRESOLVED is the licensed disposition.
